name: Portofino (Italy)
description: Blue field with a white embattled rectangular frame, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Portofino (a tower on the sea between pine branches).
history: Municipal flag of Portofino, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Portofino arms — tower on the sea, crowned, within pine branches
